why_it_moved.text: Reformulation Rate rose 5.50% alongside Queries per User (+2.60%): people re-search because results are worse.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate, the hypothesis metric, fell 0.45%, mostly on informational queries (-0.85%). Cuts are unregistered, so exploratory.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: Autocomplete Acceptance rose 0.97%; whether it feeds extra queries is untested.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: Per-query success and a repeat of the same query within 5 minutes, by arm, showing no rise in repeats would back the lift.
A registered primary of Successful Search Rate, as the hypothesis states, would make its fall the deciding result.
A pre-exposure comparison of Queries per User would settle the check that could not run.

analyst_view.reason: The registered primary counts volume; success fell and reformulation rose, so the scripted call should go to triage as a trade-off.
